title: Strict report-evidence gate accepts missing and hash-inconsistent runtime results
title_de: Striktes Report-Evidence-Gate akzeptiert fehlende und hash-inkonsistente Runtime-Resultate
summary: The strict verified-report evidence gate originally accepted critical missing input status and did not recompute declared output hashes or byte counts. PR #59 revalidation also proved that a `present` critical input using lexical `..` traversal could authenticate a correctly hashed external regular file because root containment used `.absolute()` rather than normalized paths.
summary_de: Das strikte Verified-Report-Evidence-Gate akzeptierte ursprünglich kritischen fehlenden Input-Status und berechnete deklarierte Output-Hashes oder Byte-Zahlen nicht neu. Die PR-#59-Revalidierung bewies zusätzlich, dass ein `present`-kritischer Input mit lexikalischer `..`-Traversal eine korrekt gehashte externe reguläre Datei authentifizieren konnte, weil das Root-Containment `.absolute()` statt normalisierter Pfade verwendete.
observed_behavior: On the strict gate path verified-report-governance.yml:49 → Makefile:392 → check-generated-report-layout.py, critical report-refresh records full_runtime_matrix, full_matrix_job_completeness, and verified_runtime_mismatch_analysis have input_status=missing but are not named by the strict checker. The canonical verified-run manifest declares full-runtime-matrix.generated.json as SHA-256 e3510bad867fdcf97ee0892378b608c484c081b568334b85f55784354d103711 and 12419 bytes; the checked file is SHA-256 3f41446a7fb73a361c12e31507673774698ec41d108f2c8e75c8c57b8d2ef007 and 12418 bytes, but strict output emits no mismatch. A focused current-worktree fixture additionally showed that `BUILD_ROOT:../outside-runtime.json`, `framework:../outside-runtime.json`, and `../outside-runtime.json` each passed with a matching hash for an external regular file. Governance-only passes while strict fails only for unrelated stale reports.
observed_behavior_de: Auf dem strikten Gate-Pfad verified-report-governance.yml:49 → Makefile:392 → check-generated-report-layout.py haben die kritischen Report-Refresh-Records full_runtime_matrix, full_matrix_job_completeness und verified_runtime_mismatch_analysis input_status=missing, werden aber vom strikten Checker nicht benannt. Das kanonische Verified-Run-Manifest deklariert full-runtime-matrix.generated.json mit SHA-256 e3510bad867fdcf97ee0892378b608c484c081b568334b85f55784354d103711 und 12419 Bytes; die geprüfte Datei hat SHA-256 3f41446a7fb73a361c12e31507673774698ec41d108f2c8e75c8c57b8d2ef007 und 12418 Bytes, aber die strikte Ausgabe meldet keinen Mismatch. Ein fokussiertes Current-Worktree-Fixture zeigte zusätzlich, dass `BUILD_ROOT:../outside-runtime.json`, `framework:../outside-runtime.json` und `../outside-runtime.json` jeweils mit passendem Hash einer externen regulären Datei bestanden. Governance-only besteht, während strict nur wegen unabhängiger veralteter Reports scheitert.
expected_behavior: Strict evidence acceptance requires a valid run ID, a detached command receipt and full twelve-cell runtime matrix, job-local regular artifact paths, matching connector/profile/run identity, and freshly recomputed hashes and byte counts. Critical input containment is compared after path/root normalization and still rejects any leaf or intermediate symlink. Missing, empty, unknown, partial, stale, blocked, skipped, failed, or interrupted critical runtime inputs fail closed. A dashboard or report name cannot create runtime authenticity.
expected_behavior_de: Strikte Evidence-Akzeptanz verlangt eine valide Run-ID, einen abgekoppelten Command-Receipt und eine vollständige Runtime-Matrix mit zwölf Zellen, job-lokale reguläre Artefaktpfade, passende Connector-/Profil-/Run-Identität sowie neu berechnete Hashes und Byte-Zahlen. Kritisches Input-Containment wird nach Pfad-/Root-Normalisierung verglichen und weist weiterhin jede Leaf- oder Zwischen-Symlink-Komponente zurück. Fehlende, leere, unbekannte, partielle, veraltete, blockierte, übersprungene, fehlgeschlagene oder unterbrochene kritische Runtime-Inputs scheitern geschlossen. Ein Dashboard oder Report-Dateiname kann keine Runtime-Authentizität erzeugen.
impact: A forged or copied report/manifest can make derived full-matrix and mismatch diagnostics look complete without proving that a matching raw runtime run, artifact chain, checksum, connector, or profile exists. A forged critical-input receipt could also use lexical traversal and a known digest to make an external regular file appear trusted. The workflow wiring in FND-PARENT-0024 is correct but its strict gate must enforce this result-file authenticity boundary.
impact_de: Ein gefälschter oder kopierter Report bzw. ein Manifest kann abgeleitete Full-Matrix- und Mismatch-Diagnostik vollständig aussehen lassen, ohne einen passenden Raw-Runtime-Run, eine Artefaktkette, Prüfsumme, Connector oder Profil nachzuweisen. Ein gefälschtes Critical-Input-Receipt konnte außerdem lexikalische Traversal und einen bekannten Digest verwenden, um eine externe reguläre Datei vertrauenswürdig erscheinen zu lassen. Die Workflow-Verdrahtung in FND-PARENT-0024 ist korrekt, aber ihr striktes Gate muss diese Result-File-Authentizitätsgrenze erzwingen.
preconditions: The verified-report workflow invokes the strict generated-report layout checker.
A generated report, manifest, or dashboard is present with attacker-controlled or stale declared status, size, hash, or identity fields.
A critical input receipt can name a path and a matching digest for an external readable regular file.
The absent or inconsistent raw runtime receipt is not independently recomputed by the checker.
reproduction: Run the layout checker in governance-only mode and observe PASS.
Run it in strict mode and observe unrelated stale-report failures but no error for the named critical missing input records or the declared full-runtime-matrix hash/byte mismatch.

Run the focused critical-input fixture with BUILD_ROOT:, framework:, and unprefixed ../ traversal values plus matching external-file SHA-256 values; before the normalized containment fix, each is accepted.

Inspect check_manifest, check_critical_report_run_consistency, and check_verified_runtime_diagnostics to confirm that only stale/blocked status is rejected and no declared output checksum is recomputed.

root_cause: The strict consumer validated only selected derived-report status claims and file existence. It rejected stale/blocked values but not missing or other non-verified states, did not require list-typed aggregate status fields, and never recomputed detached artifact hashes or validated the raw full-matrix job chain. The producer's manifest rewrite also dropped evidence identity and hash fields that the consumer would need to verify. In the PR #59 present-input correction, `resolve_input_reference()` retained `..` and `is_within()` compared `.absolute()` paths, so lexical containment could disagree with the physical file target. This is distinct from FND-PARENT-0031: even a mutually consistent mutable job/raw/leaf chain still lacks a detached Parent producer receipt.
root_cause_de: Der strikte Consumer validierte nur ausgewählte abgeleitete Report-Status-Claims und die Datei-Existenz. Er wies stale/blocked zurück, aber nicht missing oder andere nicht verifizierte Zustände, verlangte keine listen-typisierten aggregierten Statusfelder und berechnete keine abgekoppelten Artefakt-Hashes neu bzw. validierte keine Raw-Full-Matrix-Jobkette. Das Manifest-Rewrite des Producers verwarf außerdem Evidence-Identity- und Hash-Felder, die der Consumer zur Prüfung benötigt. In der PR-#59-Present-Input-Korrektur bewahrte `resolve_input_reference()` `..`, während `is_within()` `.absolute()`-Pfade verglich, sodass lexikalisches Containment vom physischen Dateiziel abweichen konnte. Dies ist von FND-PARENT-0031 getrennt: Selbst eine gegenseitig konsistente veränderbare Job/Raw/Leaf-Kette besitzt noch keinen abgekoppelten Parent-Producer-Receipt.
proposed_remediation: On a separate Parent-only branch, introduce a strict verifier that starts at a validated run ID and detached verified-commands receipt, derives the complete twelve-cell raw matrix path topology rather than trusting free-form report paths, validates job identity/status/schema and job-local regular artifacts, and recomputes hashes and sizes. Require allowlisted critical input states and list-typed aggregate/input records, preserve evidence identity fields during raw-manifest rewrite, and emit list-typed refresh records. Normalize both claimed input paths and trusted roots before containment comparison while continuing to reject intermediate and leaf symlink components. Preserve self-generated manifest exclusions rather than attempting a self-referential hash fixed point. The follow-on detached aggregate producer receipt is deliberately FND-PARENT-0031, not part of this change.
proposed_remediation_de: Auf einem separaten Parent-only-Branch einen strikten Verifier einführen, der bei einer validierten Run-ID und einem abgekoppelten verified-commands-Receipt beginnt, die Topologie der vollständigen Raw-Matrix mit zwölf Zellen ableitet statt frei formatierte Report-Pfade zu vertrauen, Job-Identity/Status/Schema und job-lokale reguläre Artefakte validiert sowie Hashes und Größen neu berechnet. Allowlist-kritische Input-Zustände und listen-typisierte aggregierte/Input-Records verlangen, Evidence-Identity-Felder beim Raw-Manifest-Rewrite bewahren und listen-typisierte Refresh-Records ausgeben. Beanspruchte Input-Pfade und vertrauenswürdige Roots vor dem Containment-Vergleich normalisieren und weiterhin Zwischen- sowie Leaf-Symlink-Komponenten ablehnen. Self-generated-Manifest-Exclusions bewahren statt einen selbstreferenziellen Hash-Fixpunkt zu versuchen. Der Folge-Receipt eines abgekoppelten Aggregate-Producers ist absichtlich FND-PARENT-0031 und nicht Teil dieser Änderung.
acceptance_criteria: Strict mode rejects missing runtime manifests, foreign run IDs, copied connector/profile records, unsafe artifact paths, checksum/byte mismatches, and incomplete matrix jobs.
Strict mode recomputes detached artifact hashes/sizes and derives expected job paths rather than trusting report filenames or PASS strings.
A complete twelve-cell canonical run with matching hashes, identities, and regular job-local artifacts passes the focused verifier.
The strict checker rejects all non-verified critical input states while governance-only remains explicitly non-runtime evidence.
Critical-input receipts with BUILD_ROOT:, framework:, or unprefixed lexical parent traversal fail closed even when the external file digest matches.
Self-generated manifest records are excluded or modeled as detached receipts without accepting a self-reference as proof.
The existing FND-PARENT-0024 workflow wiring remains unchanged; no Framework/MRTS change, report hand-edit, suppression, or merge occurs.

history.detail: Direct strict/gov-only executions and canonical manifest comparison confirmed that strict mode omits critical missing-input and declared hash/byte mismatch errors. Separate Parent fixture-first remediation is authorized; PR #55 remains unchanged.

The isolated Parent implementation rejects forged checksum/PASS content, missing raw manifests, incomplete and foreign runs, copied connector/profile receipts, direct and intermediate symlink escapes, malformed or unrecognized critical status schemas, and retains a twelve-cell valid control. Governance-only remains non-runtime evidence; strict mode now fails closed on retained stale/missing Cross inputs. FND-PARENT-0031 was allocated separately after a coordinated mutable-receipt forgery reproduction.

A focused security diff review of PR #59 confirmed that its new strict status allowlist still accepted a non-existent or substituted critical input when metadata self-declared status=present. The current task-owned correction requires a trusted regular file and matching SHA-256, with missing, empty, symlink, and digest-mismatch negative controls plus a legitimate control passing locally. The narrow fix compares resolve(strict=False) path/root values while retaining leaf/intermediate symlink rejection. The 32-test focused suite passes the original and alternate traversal controls, manifest/metadata digest mismatch controls, summary/JSONL fallback, and a legitimate in-root receipt; the exact PR-head/master delivery cycle remains pending.
